In the first quarter of 2023, Bank of America reported that its consumer banking business delivered its eighth consecutive quarter of strong operating leverage, driven by top-line revenue growth of 21% and expense increases of 11%. The company noted it had achieved seven quarters of overall operating leverage at that time.

Fifth Third reported nine points of year-over-year positive operating leverage in the first quarter of 2023, which was driven by an 18% increase in revenue.
